# =========================================================================
# With Time blocks
# =========================================================================
# Input parameters - fixed
n<- 28 # population size
ct.rates<-3 # avg number of daily contacts per day
nSeeds<-1 # number of cases starting the epidemic
R0<-1.5 # average number of secondary cases generated per infected individual in a fully susceptible population
t.stop  <- 360 # maximum number of days the simulation is running (if infected cases present)

# Compute the reproduction number related to the selected network
source("C:\\Users\\Chau\\Downloads\\F\\Statistics UHasselt\\Semester 4\\Master Thesis\\Master-Thesis---Chau-\\SEIR_contact-rates.R")
nSim<-1000
nSeed<-01042026
set.seed(nSeed)

# Define roles for all individuals 
roles <- c(rep("vol", 24), rep("staff", 4))  

# Initialize result storage
baseline_results <- list() 
group_results <- list() 
strict_results <- list()
common_results <- list()

for (i in 1:nSim) {
  if (i %% 100 == 0) {
    cat("Simulation:", i, "/", nSim, "\n")}
  
  # Scenario 1: Free mixing (baseline)
  baseline_results[[i]] <- sim.epi_seir(
    n = n, ct.rates = ct.rates, nSeeds = nSeeds, R0 = R0,
    t.stop = t.stop, roles = roles, average_mod = average_mod)
  
  # Scenario 2: Staff-bridge - Volunteers in rooms + Staff moving between
  # IDs 1-12: Volunteers Group A | IDs 13-24: Volunteers Group B | IDs 25-28: Staff
  volunteers_a <- 12
  volunteers_b <- 12
  staff  <- 4
  
  scenario2 <- c(rep(1, volunteers_a), rep(2, volunteers_b), rep(3, staff))
  
  # Mixing Matrix (M) for 3 groups:
  M_bridge <- matrix(c(
    0.90, 0.00, 0.10,  # Group 1 (Volunteers A) stays in Room A (90%), only sees Staff (10%)
    0.00, 0.90, 0.10,  # Group 2 (Volunteers B) stays in Room B (90%), only sees Staff (10%)
    0.40, 0.40, 0.20   # Group 3 (Staff) visits A (40%), B (40%), and other Staff (20%)
  ), nrow = 3, byrow = TRUE)

  group_results[[i]] <- sim.epi_seir(
    n = n, ct.rates = ct.rates, nSeeds = nSeeds, R0 = R0, t.stop = t.stop, 
    roles = roles, average_mod = average_mod, group_assign = scenario2, M = M_bridge)

  # Scenario 3: Strict-cohorting - Staff A for Group A, Staff B for Group B
  volunteers_room <- 12
  staff_room <- 2
  
  # Group 1: Volunteers A | Group 2: Volunteers B | Group 3: Staff A | Group 4: Staff B
  scenario3 <- c(rep(1, volunteers_room), rep(2, volunteers_room), rep(3, staff_room), rep(4, staff_room))
  
  # Matrix M for 4 groups: Staff A (Group 3) only meets Volunteers A (Group 1). Staff B (Group 4) only meets Volunteers B (Group 2).
  # There is no overlap between Group (1,3) and Group (2,4)
  M_strict <- matrix(c(
    0.90, 0.00, 0.10, 0.00,  # Group 1 (Volunteers A) stays in Room A (90%), only sees Staff A (10%)
    0.00, 0.90, 0.00, 0.10,  # Group 2 (Volunteers B) stays in Room B (90%), only sees Staff B (10%)
    0.50, 0.00, 0.50, 0.00,  # Group 3 (Staff A) visits A (50%), and other Staff A (50%)
    0.00, 0.50, 0.00, 0.50   # Group 4 (Staff B) visits B (50%), and other Staff B (50%)
  ), nrow = 4, byrow = TRUE)

  strict_results[[i]] <- sim.epi_seir(
    n = n, ct.rates = ct.rates, nSeeds = nSeeds, R0 = R0, t.stop = t.stop,
    roles = roles, average_mod = average_mod, group_assign = scenario3, M = M_strict)
  
  # Scenario 4: Common staff room - Staff A for Group A, Staff B for Group B, 2 Staff groups meet each other at common room after work
  
  # Group 1: Volunteers A | Group 2: Volunteers B | Group 3: Staff A | Group 4: Staff B
  scenario4 <- c(rep(1, volunteers_room), rep(2, volunteers_room), rep(3, staff_room), rep(4, staff_room))
  
  # Matrix M for 4 groups: Staff A (Group 3) only meets Volunteers A (Group 1). Staff B (Group 4) only meets Volunteers B (Group 2). 2 Staff groups meet each other at common room after work
  M_common <- matrix(c(
    0.90, 0.00, 0.10, 0.00,  # Group 1 (Volunteers A) stays in Room A (90%), only sees Staff A (10%)
    0.00, 0.90, 0.00, 0.10,  # Group 2 (Volunteers B) stays in Room B (90%), only sees Staff B (10%)
    0.45, 0.00, 0.45, 0.10,  # Group 3 (Staff A) visits Vol A (45%), Staff A (45%), Staff B (10%)
    0.00, 0.45, 0.10, 0.45   # Group 4 (Staff B) visits Vol B (45%), Staff B (45%), Staff A (10%)
  ), nrow = 4, byrow = TRUE)

  common_results[[i]] <- sim.epi_seir(
    n = n, ct.rates = ct.rates, nSeeds = nSeeds, R0 = R0, t.stop = t.stop,
    roles = roles, average_mod = average_mod, 
    group_assign = scenario4, M = M_common)
}

# =========================================================================
# Placebo & Vaccine Loop (Volunteers only)
# =========================================================================
vacc_coverage <- 0.5
VE_levels <- c(0, 0.3, 0.5, 0.7, 0.9)  # 0 = placebo
vacc_results <- list()

for (ve in VE_levels) {
  ve_name <- paste0("VE_", ve * 100)
  
  vacc_results[[ve_name]] <- list(
    baseline = list(),
    group    = list(),
    strict   = list(),
    common   = list()
  )
  
  for (i in 1:nSim) {
    if (i %% 100 == 0) cat("VE =", ve, "| Simulation:", i, "/", nSim, "\n")
    sim_seed <- i * 100

    set.seed(sim_seed)
    vacc_results[[ve_name]]$baseline[[i]] <- sim.epi_seir(
      n=n, ct.rates=ct.rates, nSeeds=nSeeds, R0=R0, t.stop=t.stop,
      roles=roles, average_mod=average_mod,
      vacc_coverage=vacc_coverage, vacc_efficacy_sus=ve, vacc_target="vol")

    set.seed(sim_seed)
    vacc_results[[ve_name]]$group[[i]] <- sim.epi_seir(
      n=n, ct.rates=ct.rates, nSeeds=nSeeds, R0=R0, t.stop=t.stop,
      roles=roles, average_mod=average_mod,
      group_assign=scenario2, M=M_bridge,
      vacc_coverage=vacc_coverage, vacc_efficacy_sus=ve, vacc_target="vol")

    set.seed(sim_seed)
    vacc_results[[ve_name]]$strict[[i]] <- sim.epi_seir(
      n=n, ct.rates=ct.rates, nSeeds=nSeeds, R0=R0, t.stop=t.stop,
      roles=roles, average_mod=average_mod,
      group_assign=scenario3, M=M_strict,
      vacc_coverage=vacc_coverage, vacc_efficacy_sus=ve, vacc_target="vol")

    set.seed(sim_seed)
    vacc_results[[ve_name]]$common[[i]] <- sim.epi_seir(
      n=n, ct.rates=ct.rates, nSeeds=nSeeds, R0=R0, t.stop=t.stop,
      roles=roles, average_mod=average_mod,
      group_assign=scenario4, M=M_common,
      vacc_coverage=vacc_coverage, vacc_efficacy_sus=ve, vacc_target="vol")
  }
}

# =========================================================================
# Plot Attack Rate for 4 scenarios
# =========================================================================
# Function to calculate metrics for a list of simulation results
get_metrics <- function(results_list, n, min_cases = 3) {
  # Count total ever-infected (including index case)
  total_infected <- sapply(results_list, function(res) {
    sum(res$status.matrix$infected != 0) # includes index case
  })
  
  attack_rates <- total_infected / n
  
  # Major outbreak: at least min_cases total infections (including index)
  # With n=28: 3/28 = 10.7% ≈ 10% threshold
  is_extinct   <- total_infected < min_cases
  
  return(list(ar = attack_rates, 
              total_infected = total_infected, 
              extinct_rate   = mean(is_extinct)))
}

# Calculate metrics for the 4 scenarios
m_baseline <- get_metrics(baseline_results, n)
m_group    <- get_metrics(group_results, n)
m_strict   <- get_metrics(strict_results, n)
m_common   <- get_metrics(common_results, n)

  # Set up side-by-side bar plots
  par(mfrow=c(1, 4)) 
  # Scenario 1: Free mixing 
  hist(m_baseline$ar, main="Scenario 1", xlab="Attack Rate", col="#0072B2", xlim=c(0,1), breaks=20)
  # Scenario 2: Staff-bridge 
  hist(m_group$ar, main="Scenario 2", xlab="Attack Rate", col="#D55E00", xlim=c(0,1), breaks=20)
  # Scenario 3: Strict-cohorting 
  hist(m_strict$ar, main="Scenario 3", xlab="Attack Rate", col="#009E73", xlim=c(0,1), breaks=20)
  # Scenario 4: Common staff room 
  hist(m_common$ar, main="Scenario 4", xlab="Attack Rate", col="#CC79A7", xlim=c(0,1), breaks=20)

# =========================================================================
# Plot Outbreak Probability for 4 scenarios
# =========================================================================
  # Set up side-by-side bar plots
  par(mfrow=c(1, 4))
  # Quick helper function for bar plots
  plot_outcome <- function(m_data, title) {
  barplot(c(Extinct = m_data$extinct_rate, Major = 1 - m_data$extinct_rate), 
          main = title, col = c("grey", "orange"), ylab = "Probability", ylim=c(0,1))
}
  # Generate plots for the 4 scenarios
  plot_outcome(m_baseline, "Scenario 1")
  plot_outcome(m_group, "Scenario 2")
  plot_outcome(m_strict, "Scenario 3")
  plot_outcome(m_common, "Scenario 4")

# =========================================================================
# Plot Attack Rate (Non-extinct) for 4 scenarios
# =========================================================================
  # Set layout to 1 row and 4 columns
  par(mfrow=c(1, 4), mar=c(4.4, 4.1, 3.1, 1.1))
  # List of results to iterate through
  scenarios_list <- list(Scenario_1 = baseline_results, 
                         Scenario_2 = group_results, 
                         Scenario_3 = strict_results,
                         Scenario_4 = common_results)
  # Colors for the 4 plots
  colors <- c("#0072B2", "#D55E00", "#009E73", "#CC79A7")
  
  for(i in 1:length(scenarios_list)) {
  current_res <- scenarios_list[[i]]
  name <- names(scenarios_list)[i]
  
  # Filter for Major outbreaks 
  m <- get_metrics(current_res, n)
  major_ar <- m$ar[m$total_infected >= 3]
  
  # Draw histogram
  if(length(major_ar) > 0) {
    hist(major_ar, main = paste(name, ": Major AR"), 
         xlab = "Proportion Infected", ylab = "Frequency",
         col  = colors[i], 
         xlim = c(0, 1),      # Fixed X-axis
         ylim = c(0, 100),    # Unified Y-axis set to 100
         breaks = seq(0, 1, by=0.1))
  } else {
    # Placeholder for scenarios with no major outbreaks
    plot(NULL, xlim=c(0,1), ylim=c(0,100), 
         main = paste(name, ": No Major Outbreak"), 
         xlab = "Proportion Infected", ylab = "Frequency", axes = TRUE)
    text(0.5, 50, "0% Major Outbreaks", col = "red", cex = 1.2)
  }
  }

# =========================================================================
# Plot Attack Rate by Vaccine Efficacy Levels
# =========================================================================
get_ar <- function(res_list, n) {
  sapply(res_list, function(x) sum(x$status.matrix$infected != 0) / n)
}

df_ve <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(vacc_results), function(ve_name) {
  ve_val <- as.numeric(sub("VE_", "", ve_name)) / 100
  
  do.call(rbind, list(
    data.frame(AR       = get_ar(vacc_results[[ve_name]]$baseline, n),
               Scenario = "Scenario 1", VE = ve_val),
    data.frame(AR       = get_ar(vacc_results[[ve_name]]$group, n),
               Scenario = "Scenario 2", VE = ve_val),
    data.frame(AR       = get_ar(vacc_results[[ve_name]]$strict, n),
               Scenario = "Scenario 3", VE = ve_val),
    data.frame(AR       = get_ar(vacc_results[[ve_name]]$common, n),
               Scenario = "Scenario 4", VE = ve_val)
  ))
}))

df_ve$VE <- factor(df_ve$VE, levels = c(0, 0.3, 0.5, 0.7, 0.9),
                   labels = c("Placebo\n(VE=0)", "VE=30%", 
                              "VE=50%", "VE=70%", "VE=90%"))

# Plot: Attack Rate (major outbreaks only)
df_major_ve <- df_ve[df_ve$AR >= 3/n, ]

ggplot(df_major_ve, aes(x = VE, y = AR, fill = VE)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7, outlier.size = 0.5) +
  facet_wrap(~ Scenario, nrow = 1) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Placebo\n(VE=0)" = "#999999",
                               "VE=30%"          = "#0072B2",
                               "VE=50%"          = "#D55E00",
                               "VE=70%"          = "#009E73",
                               "VE=90%"          = "#CC79A7")) +
  labs(title = "Attack Rate (Major Outbreaks) by Vaccine Efficacy Levels",
       x = NULL, y = "Attack Rate (proportion infected)",
       fill = "Vaccine Efficacy") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        axis.text.x = element_blank())

ggsave("Attack_Rate_VE_levels.png", width = 12, height = 6, dpi = 300)

# Table: Probability of Major Outbreak by VE Level
get_ar <- function(res_list, n) {
  sapply(res_list, function(x) sum(x$status.matrix$infected != 0) / n)
}

scenarios <- list(
  "Scenario 1" = "baseline",
  "Scenario 2" = "group",
  "Scenario 3" = "strict",
  "Scenario 4" = "common"
)

ve_labels <- c("VE_0"="Placebo", "VE_30"="VE=30%", 
               "VE_50"="VE=50%", "VE_70"="VE=70%", 
               "VE_90"="VE=90%")

df_table <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(scenarios), function(sc_name) {
  sc_key <- scenarios[[sc_name]]
  row <- data.frame(Scenario = sc_name)
  for (ve_name in names(ve_labels)) {
    total_inf <- sapply(vacc_results[[ve_name]][[sc_key]], function(x) {
      sum(x$status.matrix$infected != 0)
    })
    row[[ve_labels[ve_name]]] <- round(mean(total_inf >= 3), 3)
  }
  row
}))

print(df_table)

# =========================================================================
# Attack Rates by VE Levels (ALL simulations, including extinct)
# =========================================================================
# Table Mean AR
df_unconditional <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(scenarios), function(sc_name) {
  sc_key <- scenarios[[sc_name]]
  row <- data.frame(Scenario = sc_name)
  for (ve_name in names(ve_labels)) {
    ar <- get_ar(vacc_results[[ve_name]][[sc_key]], n)
    row[[ve_labels[ve_name]]] <- round(mean(ar), 3)  # mean over ALL sims
  }
  row
}))
print(df_unconditional)

# Boxplot: Total AR 
ggplot(df_ve, aes(x = VE, y = AR, fill = VE)) +

```{r}
# =========================================================================
# Calibration Check With & Without Time blocks
# =========================================================================
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(patchwork)
library(scales)

set.seed(123)
nSim_val <- 1000

# 1. Run 2 versions
# Version 1: No time blocks
val_no_blocks <- replicate(nSim_val, {
  s <- sim.epi_seir(n = n, ct.rates = ct.rates, nSeeds = nSeeds,
    R0 = R0, t.stop = t.stop, roles = roles,
    average_mod = 1, # no time blocks
    group_assign = NULL, M = NULL)
  sum(s$status.matrix$infected != 0) / n
})

# Version 2: Calibrated (with time blocks)
val_with_blocks <- replicate(nSim_val, {
  s <- sim.epi_seir(n = n, ct.rates = ct.rates, nSeeds = nSeeds,
    R0 = R0, t.stop = t.stop, roles = roles,
    average_mod = average_mod,    # calibrated (with time blocks)
    group_assign = NULL, M = NULL)
  sum(s$status.matrix$infected != 0) / n
})

# 2. Summary statistics
cat("\n=== Calibration Check Summary ===\n")
summary_cal <- data.frame(
  Version       = c("No Time Blocks", "Calibrated"),
  Mean_AR       = round(c(mean(val_no_blocks),
                           mean(val_with_blocks)), 3),
  Median_AR     = round(c(median(val_no_blocks),
                           median(val_with_blocks)), 3),
  P_outbreak    = round(c(mean(val_no_blocks  > 0.10),
                           mean(val_with_blocks > 0.10)), 3),
  P_major       = round(c(mean(val_no_blocks >= 3/n),
                        mean(val_with_blocks >= 3/n)), 3)
)
print(summary_cal)

# 3. Build dataframe
df_val <- data.frame(
  AR      = c(val_no_blocks, val_with_blocks),
  Version = rep(c("No Time Blocks\n(average_mod = 1)",
                  "Calibrated\n(with Time Blocks)"), each = nSim_val))

df_val$Version <- factor(
  df_val$Version,
  levels = c("No Time Blocks\n(average_mod = 1)",
             "Calibrated\n(with Time Blocks)"))

# Major outbreaks only
df_major <- df_val %>% filter(AR >= 3/n)
# Annotation
ann_major <- df_major %>% group_by(Version) %>%
  summarise(mean_AR = round(mean(AR), 3), med_AR  = round(median(AR), 3),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(label = paste0("mean=", mean_AR, "\nmedian=", med_AR))

# Plot
p_cal <- ggplot(df_major, aes(x = Version, y = AR, fill = Version)) +
  geom_violin(trim = TRUE, alpha = 0.85) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.08, fill = "white", outlier.shape = NA, color = "grey30") +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "point", shape = 21, size = 3,
               fill = "red", color = "black") +
  geom_text(data = ann_major, aes(x = Version, y = 0.92, label = label),
            size = 3.5, color = "grey30", lineheight = 0.9) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "No Time Blocks\n(average_mod = 1)" = "#0072B2",
      "Calibrated\n(with Time Blocks)"    = "#D55E00"), guide = "none") +
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1)) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0.10, 1)) +
  labs(title    = "Calibration Check: Attack Rate Distribution",
       subtitle = paste0("Major outbreaks | R0 = ", R0,
                         " | n = ", nSim_val, " simulations | Red dot = mean"),
       x = NULL, y = "Final Attack Rate") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), 
        plot.subtitle    = element_text(color = "grey40", size = 9))

print(p_cal)
ggsave("validation_calibration_violin.png", p_cal, width = 7, height = 5, dpi = 300)
```
